verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a Batch processing API for turning audio files into text, and job deletion confirms a job-based file workflow. The evidence never names the submission endpoint, the accepted audio/video formats, or the file-size limits the story requires. Missing for 10: a documented file-upload endpoint path, published accepted formats (including video), published size/duration limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a local audio or video file for transcription through a documented API endpoint, with accepted formats and size limits published

citations.quote: Use Batch processing to accurately turn your audio files into text
Delete a job and remove all associated resources.
